prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic high-fashion vertical portrait of an adult woman with shoulder-length bronde hair and soft curtain bangs beneath classical European stone arches. She wears an oversized black leather biker jacket with natural creases, black tailored trousers, brown leather ankle boots, thick gold hoop earrings, and a large structured brown leather tote on one shoulder. She stands with a gently turned shoulder, one hand resting on the tote strap, and a direct neutral confident gaze. Frame her in a classical stone corridor with repeating arches, a vaulted ceiling, wrought-iron gates, and soft diffused daylight from the open end behind her. Use a natural low-to-eye-level full-length perspective, sharp focus on the subject, softly blurred arches, realistic leather, natural proportions, and muted black-brown-gray-beige editorial color.
